name: Three-Ways
why_founding: Unknown builders raised a platform where three walkways meet. A seller of food later set up on the platform.
why_site_advantages: The site is a firm root mass. The root mass is big enough to anchor three spans.
why_occupants_motive: A family runs the platform. The family charges nothing for passage, but charges for tea.
why_pressures: Everyone in the district passes through the junction. Every argument in the district therefore happens at the junction.
why_would_change_if: If one span were lost, the junction would become a dead end. The family would then move.
vibe_silhouette: The silhouette is a wide platform where plank lines converge.
vibe_palette: The palette is plank grey, one red awning and lamp amber.
vibe_materials: The materials are planks, a lashed shelter and a hanging lamp.
vibe_signature_feature: A lamp is kept lit at the junction. Three walkways meet there and none has a sign.
vibe_condition: well used, well repaired
vibe_approach: Voices carry from two spans away.
vibe_senses: kettle, feet, three conversations
player_purpose_hook: The junction marks where three walkways meet. A family sells tea here from a platform anchored on a firm root mass.
deferred_why: The place was deferred in the verify/wrap round rebalance. The region ran over its coverage-doc record budget (docs/research/phase11/phase11-critique/coverage-density.md S2) after its executor pass. The place is a lowest-value fine-tempo fill in an over-dense zone. It was chosen so no type falls under-band. The record is intact. Part 3's homeless-batch review may restore it.

name: Counts-The-Shells
why_founding: One dwelling stands here with no path to it. The occupant left Archon and did not explain why.
why_site_advantages: The ground is deliberately awkward and lies inside the D4 wall. It is an island in flooded root country with no landing.
why_occupants_motive: One person lives here. The person has arranged a life's worth of one obsession in order.
why_pressures: Reaching the hermit costs a day. The hermit trades knowledge only for a specific favour.
why_would_change_if: If a visitor did the favour, the coast would gain a piece of knowledge that no other person holds.
vibe_silhouette: A single thin smoke line rises above the canopy. No path runs under the smoke.
vibe_palette: The palette is one warm point in a lot of dark green.
vibe_materials: The hut is built entirely from materials that were to hand.
vibe_signature_feature: The hut holds hundreds of catalogued items. The items are arranged with total precision.
vibe_condition: small, perfect, obsessive
vibe_mood: The reward is a conversation, not loot.
vibe_approach: No route leads to the hut. A visitor has to make a route.
vibe_senses: The hermit has not spoken to anyone in months. The hermit's voice is the single voice here.
player_purpose_hook: The ground is deliberately awkward and lies inside the D4 wall. It is an island in flooded root country with no landing.

The place is deferred as surplus. The type 'hermit-hut' is over its province count band (6 max). name: Still-Water Sleeping-Tree
why_founding: The Hist opened a break in the canopy on a firm rise at the marsh edge. The village that answered the break stood there for generations.
why_site_advantages: The site is a firm rise where the fringe marsh met the jungle wall. The site has fresh water. The Hist made the canopy break itself.
why_occupants_motive: No household has lived here since the still water rose. The water rose over the sleeping tree and the xanmeer beneath it.
why_pressures: A guardian holds the drowned chamber under the tree. The guardian stays among the remains of the village.
why_would_change_if: If the water ever drained, the tree and the xanmeer beneath it would be exposed. They would be visible for the first time in living memory.
vibe_silhouette: A drowned crown breaks the water's surface. The canopy once broke over the huts at that spot.
vibe_palette: The water is still and black. Amber bark is bleached pale underwater. Deep green closes in from the banks.
vibe_materials: The mud-and-render huts have collapsed and silted over. The raised uxith is submerged. Worked stone of the xanmeer is visible below the surface.
vibe_signature_feature: The sleeping tree's crown is half submerged. An underwater entry leads down through the flooded chambers beneath it.
vibe_condition: The place is drowned and unchanged since the water rose. The xanmeer stone holds where the timber has not.
vibe_approach: The drowned crown shows first, from a distance across open water. The hut lines on the bank come after.
vibe_senses: No chimes sound now. Water laps the exposed crown. A cold comes up from the deep dive.
why_site_won: flood high in fringe marsh (danger band 3), 252 m from the nearest route; its first-choice landform; won on culture-clump, landform, region.
player_purpose_hook: The village's sleeping Hist and the xanmeer beneath it stand under still water. A guardian holds the flooded chamber.

name: Takes-The-Eggs
why_founding: The bird colonies and the shell-beast grounds have rotas. The people who ignore the rotas camp in places that are not watched.
why_site_advantages: The ground is concealed. It lies within a night's walk of two protected harvest sites.
why_occupants_motive: Four or five poachers live here. They sell to a buyer in Archon. They pretend to be hunters.
why_pressures: The villages that keep the rota will kill the poachers if they catch them. Those villages say so openly.
why_would_change_if: If the Archon buyer were cut off, the camp would fold in a week.
vibe_silhouette: No smoke rises from the place where a camp obviously stands.
vibe_palette: canvas grey-green, dull, deliberately
vibe_materials: The camp has low tents, a cold pit and packed baskets.
vibe_signature_feature: Baskets of eggs are packed for a market. The buyers at the market will not ask where the eggs originated.
vibe_condition: temporary and recently moved
vibe_approach: A visitor finds the baskets before the poachers.
vibe_senses: The camp has no sound of a fire. Voices are low.
player_purpose_hook: A poaching camp hides here near two protected harvest sites. The camp's buyer in Archon moves the trade.

why_site_advantages: The site is a ridge end above the canopy. A break in the trees opens on the seaward side.
why_occupants_motive: The ledge has no occupants. The ground is worn where people have stood for centuries.
why_pressures: The climb is real. The reward is entirely informational.
why_would_change_if: The use of the ledge does not change. People have used it for four hundred years.
vibe_silhouette: A break in the canopy edge reads from below as light.
vibe_palette: The palette is green, then suddenly grey-blue distance.
vibe_materials: The materials are worn rock, a cairn and scratched names.
vibe_signature_feature: A sighting stone has three notches cut in its top edge. The notches align on three places.
vibe_condition: worn smooth
vibe_approach: The light through the canopy is the cue to the ledge.
vibe_senses: Wind blows on the ledge. It is the first quiet since a visitor entered the wall.

name: Two-Span Burrow
why_founding: Not every rootworm is tame. The untamed rootworms tear their way through wherever they like.
why_site_advantages: The ground is soft and root-bound at the edge of the rootland arm. It was torn open and left open.
why_occupants_motive: One animal lives here. The collapsed remains of an attempt to use its burrow lie at the mouth.
why_pressures: The waykeepers avoid this arm. They will not discuss why in front of paying passengers.
why_would_change_if: If the rootworm moved, the station's arm would become usable for a second line.
vibe_silhouette: A ragged mouth is torn through a bank. Sheared root collars its edges.
vibe_palette: The palette is raw earth, root white and dark inside.
vibe_materials: The materials are packed earth, sheared roots and crushed timber. Shoring was put in and lost.
vibe_signature_feature: A boarding stage was built here once. The stage is crushed flat.
vibe_condition: active
vibe_mood: The burrow shows the honest downside of the transport system.
vibe_approach: The ground shakes before a visitor finds the mouth.
vibe_senses: A deep grinding is felt through the feet. It comes from somewhere off in the dark.
player_purpose_hook: The ground is soft and root-bound at the edge of the rootland arm. A crushed boarding stage lies at the mouth of the burrow that tore the ground open.

name: Swallows-Divers
why_founding: The shaft was a ventilation or water shaft of the drowned xanmeer. It is now the only way into the xanmeer's lower galleries.
why_site_advantages: A dark opening in the water is ringed by worked stone. The lagoon has no current.
why_occupants_motive: The shaft has no residents. A rope hangs in it. A person who did not come back left the rope.
why_pressures: The descent is longer than one breath. The marks on the wall show this.
why_would_change_if: If the lagoon silted, the shaft would close. The galleries would then be sealed for good.
vibe_silhouette: The shaft is a black circle in green water. Cut stone rings the circle.
vibe_palette: The colours run green, then blue, then black.
vibe_materials: The site has worked stone, old rope and depth marks.
vibe_signature_feature: Depth marks are cut into the shaft wall. The last mark has no companion.
vibe_condition: The shaft is open. The lip is unstable.
vibe_approach: Swimmers find the shaft by swimming over it.
vibe_senses: pressure; nothing else
player_purpose_hook: A dark opening in water is ringed by worked stone. The lagoon has no current.
deferred_why: The record is deferred under coverage critique S1/S2/S3. The saxhleel-coast carried 99 records on 1.81 km2. The corrected budget was 18-24 records. It is the most over-budget zone in the province. The record is deferred as surplus. The 'dive-shaft' type is over its province count band of 4 maximum. The record is not established lore, carries no quest, is not tier 0-1 and is not an instance of an under-band vertical or underwater type. The record is intact and complete. Part 3 promotes it if the ground turns out to want it.
